name: English (US)
title: Pano Installer

inputs.title: Title (Required)
inputs.url-helper: Enter the full address where your website will be visited.
inputs.url-helper-servers: The address your panel and your Minecraft servers will use to reach Pano.
inputs.url-host-mismatch: The address you entered is different from the one you're currently using to access Pano. After setup, Pano will automatically redirect visitors arriving on other hosts (including IP addresses) to this address. If you can't reach the new address, set `website-url-redirect: false` in the config file to disable the redirect — but cross-host logins may not work because authentication cookies are bound to this host.
inputs.url-port-mismatch: The port in this address ({port}) is different from the port you're using to reach Pano right now ({current}). Make sure it's the port your visitors will actually use.
inputs.url-explicit-port: This address includes a port ({port}). If visitors reach your site through a reverse proxy (Nginx, Apache, Cloudflare) on the standard port, remove the port so links and redirects don't point to an internal one.

databases.mysql-or-mariadb-description: Manually provide the connection details for an existing MySQL or MariaDB server.
databases.local-portable-db-description: Automatically download, install and configure a portable MariaDB instance on your server. This is recommended if you don't have a database server already set up.
databases.portable-not-supported: Portable DB is not supported on this system.

email.title: SMTP
email.description: Pano requires an email provider to be able to send emails. Please log in with the e-mail service you want to use.
email.servers-intro: Pano uses e-mail to send you alerts — a server crashed, a backup failed — and to let you reset your password. Please log in with the e-mail service you want to use.

account.title: Account
account.online-account-description: Connect your online Pano account to access plugins, themes, and updates.

telemetry.label: Send {link}
telemetry.description: This data is used to make Pano better.

connect-failed-alert: Connecting your Pano account has been failed! Try again.

confirm-remove-pano-account.title: Are you sure to disconnect your online Pano account?

confirm-skip-smtp.title: Are you sure to skip setting up SMTP?
confirm-skip-smtp.description: Skipping this step may result in missing/not working features such as Password Reset or E-Mail validation.
confirm-skip-smtp.description-servers: Skipping this step means Pano can't e-mail you alerts (server crashed, backup failed) or send password reset links.

usage-data.title: Usage Data
usage-data.sent-system: Java version, OS, CPU and memory
usage-data.sent-counts: User, post, ticket, server and online player counts
usage-data.sent-install: Install date and a random install ID
usage-data.turn-off: You can turn this off anytime in Panel → Settings → Platform, or with {option} in config.conf.

toasts.pano-account-connect-success: Your Pano account has been successfully connected!
toasts.pano-account-disconnect-fail: An error occurred during the removing Pano account!

errors.PLATFORM_ALREADY_INSTALLED: Platform is already installed! Choose another database location to fix this.
errors.INVALID_DB_DATA: Can't connect to DB: Invalid data.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Network error: Can't reach to Pano, check your connection!
errors.ALREADY_CONNECTED_TO_PANO: Already connected an account to Pano servers!
errors.PANO_CONNECT_FAILED: Failed to connect Pano servers, please try again later.
errors.PANO_DISCONNECT_FAILED: Failed to disconnect Pano account, please try again later.
errors.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: An error occurred, please check Pano console and report it!
errors.DB_INSTALL_FAILED: Failed to download and install portable MariaDB.

alpha-warning.title: Alpha Version
alpha-warning.description: This version is experimental and may contain critical errors.

beta-warning.title: Beta Version
beta-warning.description: You are about to install the Beta version. Beta versions are generally release candidates, much more stable than Alpha, and include the latest features.

usage-mode.title: How will you use Pano?
usage-mode.subtitle: You can change this later in the panel settings.

website.title: Website
website.description: A website for your Minecraft server: posts, tickets, themes, player registration.

servers.title: Server management
servers.description: Console, players, backups and files for your servers. No public website.

pano-host.title: Pano Backup
pano-host.description: Sign in with your {website} account and restore one of your Pano Backups.

move.title: Pano Host
move.description: Move one of your Pano Host instances here: its files and database come over as they are now.
move.intro: Connect this Pano to your {website} account to see your Pano Host instances.
move.none: This account has no Pano Host instances.
move.note: The instance keeps running on Pano Host. End its subscription on the website once the move is done.

reasons.SUSPENDED: Suspended, so it cannot be exported.
reasons.STATE: It is being set up or changed right now, so it cannot be exported yet.
reasons.NO_PORTAL: Not placed on a server yet, so it cannot be exported.

other-pano.title: Restore from a backup file
other-pano.description: Upload a .panoarc backup or export you downloaded from a Pano panel or Pano Host.

file.label: Backup file
file.drop: Drop a backup here or click to choose
file.encrypted: This backup is encrypted. Enter the passphrase it was made with.
file.workload: This backup is locked to its Pano Host instance and can't be opened here. Download an export of it on {website} instead.
file.unknown: This is not a Pano backup file.

host.intro: Connect this Pano to your {website} account to see your Pano Backups.
host.no-backups: This account has no finished Pano Backups yet.
host.passphrase-hint: Only needed when the backup was encrypted with a passphrase.
host.connect-failed: The {website} account could not be connected. Try again.

database.title: Database to restore into
database.description: The backed-up site is restored into this MySQL or MariaDB database. Pano tables already in it are replaced.

import.restore-warning: Restoring replaces this setup with the backed-up site, including its admin accounts and settings. Pano restarts when it is done.

progress.title: Restoring your site
progress.EXPORTING: Pano Host is preparing the export of the instance...
progress.DOWNLOADING: Downloading the backup from Pano Backup...

done.title: Restore complete
done.description: Pano is restarting with the restored site. This page opens it in a moment.
done.manual: If nothing happens, restart Pano yourself and open this address again.

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach Pano. Check your connection and try again.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: Something is missing. Check the form and try again.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large to upload here.
errors.NOT_AN_ARCHIVE: This is not a Pano backup file.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: This backup was made by a newer Pano. Update Pano first.
errors.PASSPHRASE_REQUIRED: This backup is encrypted. Enter its passphrase.
errors.WRONG_PASSPHRASE: The passphrase is wrong. Nothing was changed.
errors.TAMPERED: The backup is damaged or was changed. Nothing was restored.
errors.TRUNCATED: The backup file is incomplete. Nothing was restored.
errors.INVALID_ARCHIVE: The backup file is damaged. Nothing was restored.
errors.UNSAFE_ENTRY: The backup contains unsafe files and was refused.
errors.UNSAFE_SQL: The backup's database dump contains statements Pano doesn't allow, so it was refused.
errors.TOO_LARGE: The backup is too large to restore.
errors.WRONG_KIND: This file is not a whole-site Pano backup.
errors.ARCHIVE_NEWER_THAN_TARGET: This backup was made by a newer Pano. Update Pano first, then restore it.
errors.HASH_MISMATCH: The backup failed its integrity check. Nothing was restored.
errors.RESTORE_FAILED: The restore failed. Check the Pano console for details.
errors.DATABASE_CONNECTION_FAILED: Can't connect to the database. Check the database details.
errors.PANO_HOST_UNAVAILABLE: {website} can't be reached right now. Try again later.
errors.PANO_HOST_NOT_LINKED: This Pano isn't connected to {website}. Connect again.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: The {website} connection was revoked. Connect again.
errors.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The backup couldn't be downloaded from Pano Backup. Try again.
errors.INTEGRITY_FAILED: The downloaded backup failed its integrity check. Try again.
errors.BACKUP_NOT_FOUND: That Pano Backup no longer exists.
errors.PAYMENT_REQUIRED: This {website} account has no Pano Backup plan.
errors.EXPORT_FAILED: Pano Host could not export this instance. Try again later.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: This instance was exported recently. A new export is possible once a day.
errors.TASK_IN_PROGRESS: The instance is busy with another task on Pano Host. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.PORTAL_OFFLINE: The server running this instance is offline. Try again later.
errors.PORTAL_UNSUPPORTED: The server running this instance cannot export it yet.
errors.WORKLOAD_SUSPENDED: This instance is suspended, so it cannot be exported.
errors.INVALID_WORKLOAD_STATE: This instance cannot be exported in its current state.
errors.WORKLOAD_NOT_FOUND: This instance was not found in your account.
